side_direction_conclusions: Bargaining and dispute-resolution mechanisms occur on safety, non-safety, mixed, and unclear sides; mechanism presence does not identify the sign or magnitude of a wage effect.

Interest arbitration/factfinding, grievance arbitration, settlements, collective bargaining, and strike/no-strike constraints have distinct wage-pressure pathways and must not be collapsed into a single causal mechanism.

Market/staffing rationales appear on multiple sides. Brewster police dispatchers provide a strong non-safety recruitment/retention example; Bernards records retention and Greenwich stormwater retention are false positives and should be removed.
No audited distribution supports a nationally representative, prevalence, safety-advantage, wage-gap, treatment-effect, or causal claim.
